input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only provision granting audit/inspection/verification rights against us (no other audit or inspection language appears in the document). It meets the preferred position on every material term: frequency limited to once in any twelve-month period; thirty days' prior written notice; normal business hours with no unreasonable disruption; off-site where practicable via an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1); Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent (22.2); and express prohibition on direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party confidential information (22.2). Section 22.3 adds customer-favourable protections (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of the final report, and finality on payment of the shortfall). Section 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) currently contains only a heading, but that concerns our reciprocal assurance rights and is outside the scope of this rule. No redline required.
